mapper.sql: select mo.id, mo.order_no, mo.request_no, su.user_name, mo.user_id, mo.assigned_agent_id, mo.platform_code, mo.platform_name, mo.total_count, mo.success_count, mo.failed_count, mo.total_amount, mo.refund_amount, mo.order_status, mo.audit_status, mo.audit_opinion, mo.audit_by, mo.audit_time, mo.completed_time, mo.create_by, mo.create_time, mo.update_by, mo.update_time, mo.remark, ( select moi.phone from mark_order_item moi where moi.order_id = mo.id order by case when moi.process_status = '0' then 0 else 1 end, moi.id asc limit 1 ) as phone_preview from mark_order mo left join sys_user su on su.user_id = mo.user_id
mapper.select:
select mo.id, mo.order_no, mo.request_no, su.user_name, mo.user_id, mo.assigned_agent_id, mo.platform_code, mo.platform_name, mo.total_count, mo.success_count, mo.failed_count, mo.total_amount, mo.refund_amount, mo.order_status, mo.audit_status, mo.audit_opinion, mo.audit_by, mo.audit_time, mo.completed_time, mo.create_by, mo.create_time, mo.update_by, mo.update_time, mo.remark, moi.id as item_id, moi.process_status as item_process_status, moi.processed_time as item_processed_time, moi.phone as phone_preview from mark_order mo left join sys_user su on su.user_id = mo.user_id inner join mark_order_item moi on moi.order_id = mo.id
and mo.order_no like concat('%', #{orderNo}, '%') and mo.request_no like concat('%', #{requestNo}, '%')
and ( mo.order_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or su.user_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or moi.phone like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and mo.user_id = #{userId} and mo.assigned_agent_id = #{assignedAgentId} and mo.platform_code = #{platformCode}
and moi.process_status = '0' and lower(mo.platform_code) not in ('tencent_mark', 'tengxun', 'tencent', 'tx', 'txwz')
and ( moi.process_status = '3' or ( moi.process_status = '0' and lower(mo.platform_code) in ('tencent_mark', 'tengxun', 'tencent', 'tx', 'txwz') ) )
and moi.process_status = '1' and moi.process_status = '2' and mo.audit_status = #{auditStatus} and mo.audit_status in ('1','2','3') and moi.phone like concat('%', #{phone}, '%')
and mo.create_time >= #{params.beginTime}
and mo.create_time <= concat(#{params.endTime}, ' 23:59:59')
order by mo.create_time desc, moi.id asc
mapper.insert:
insert into mark_order
order_no, request_no, user_id, assigned_agent_id, platform_code, platform_name, total_count, success_count, failed_count, total_amount, refund_amount, order_status, audit_status, audit_opinion, audit_by, audit_time, completed_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark,
#{orderNo}, #{requestNo}, #{userId}, #{assignedAgentId}, #{platformCode}, #{platformName}, #{totalCount}, #{successCount}, #{failedCount}, #{totalAmount}, #{refundAmount}, #{orderStatus}, #{auditStatus}, #{auditOpinion}, #{auditBy}, #{auditTime}, #{completedTime}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark},
mapper.select: select u.user_id from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.role_key in ('agent', 'mark_agent') where u.del_flag = '0' and u.rel_mark_template = #{templateId} order by u.user_id asc limit 1
